run_ImageEvalTransform: run ImageEvalTransform on a PIL image to resize, center crop, and normalize it for MAE evaluation
run_ImagePretrainTransform: run ImagePretrainTransform on a PIL image with random resized crop and horizontal flip for MAE pretraining
run_MixUpCutMix: run MixUpCutMix on a batch of image tensors and targets to apply mixup or cutmix augmentation
run_RandAug: run RandAug on a PIL image to apply a random sequence of 15 augmentation operations
run_AudioFineTuneTransform: run AudioFineTuneTransform on WAV bytes to extract fbank features with mixup and SpecAugment support
